name: brier
note: A reliability diagram at night: a dark ground, bone type, and one vermilion that appears only where a forecast missed. Every value here appears verbatim in src/util/fmt.ts, assets/*.svg and assets/term2png.py — there is no second palette in the repository.

chroma_rule.statement: Vermilion marks a miss. Being right is unmarked.
accent_is_for: a forecast whose bin sits away from the reference line
an overconfidence gap above five points
the section heading of whatever you are reading
chroma_rule.why: A scoreboard coloured green for good and red for bad is read as a mood before it is read as a number, and the number is the entire point. Here the only coloured thing on the page is the place a claim did not pay.

typography.family: JetBrains Mono, ui-monospace, SF Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
typography.note: One face. Every screen in this product is a column of probabilities that has to line up.
typography.caps: Section labels only. Probabilities are data and are never emphasised.

shape.note: No rounded corners, no shadows, no gradients. Depth is surface tone plus one hairline.

marks.both: ◆ in accent — the forecast told the truth
